# NFA-000: Short story title

## Status

Planned

## User story

As a user, I want a clear result so I can finish my work.

## Goal

Keep the change small. Make it easy to test.

## Dependencies

None.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The first testable result is clear.
- [ ] The second testable result is clear.
- [ ] Focused tests cover the main path.
- [ ] The matching docs and proof are updated.

## Out of scope

This story does not add later release work.
